scope: A shared CRT/SDK-free C core compares every transmitted window-state field and only active region bytes, and commits after successful queueing/submission. It fixes D3D9 stale geometry, D3D8/DDraw missing foreground-HWND changes and failed-send cache poisoning, retaining API-specific hidden/no-surface shape. Real XP produces 27 reports for 22 independently measured Win32 move/resize/foreground/hide/show/primary-release steps across three processes. Actions stop Present and pump messages; actual GPU replay verifies decoded data and surface geometry/visibility without claiming native Microsoft Direct3D drawing. All published retail DLLs are the exact accepted window-probe bytes. Existing host bundle is unchanged. Win32 capture/event consolidation, per-Present probe reuse, wrappers and stages 5/6 remain.
